summary: CaseChain is in its architecture-and-foundations delivery phase. The approved plans define the target product; a plan's approval is not a claim that every capability described in it is already shipped.

implemented.title: Plan archive and portfolio tracking
implemented.detail: The repository maintains canonical, decision-complete plans with a shared status vocabulary and cross-domain portfolio index.

implemented.title: Public project portal
implemented.detail: This lightweight static site makes the plans and a review-friendly progress snapshot easy to share without exposing the application runtime.

active.title: Design system and application shell
active.detail: The Civic Ink design-system overhaul is marked in progress.

active.title: AI extraction and model lifecycle
active.detail: The extraction/provenance implementation and hardening track is marked in progress.

remaining.title: Approved product and platform contracts
remaining.detail: The approved feature and platform plans remain the delivery backlog. They are ready for implementation in their documented dependency order.

remaining.title: Platform Operations
remaining.detail: The next new operational plan: platform administration, usage, quotas, job health, audit, and privacy boundaries.

remaining.title: External Acquisition and Imports
remaining.detail: Intentionally deferred until representative organisation spreadsheets are available.
